parsed.rationale: All four `SequentialMockSession` type-alias records are exact duplicates (`shared_field_count: 1`, `jaccard: null`, `differing_slots: null`) residing in the single file `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift` at lines 84, 211, 317, and 363. The duplication arises because each enclosing test class (`iTunesArtworkServiceTests`, `LastFMArtworkServiceTests`, `DiscogsArtworkServiceTests` — the last appearing twice, suggesting a copy-paste error) re-declares the same alias locally. Hoisting the alias to file scope once eliminates all redundancy without crossing package or file boundaries, which is why none of the standard cross-file or cross-package categories apply cleanly.

specifics.proposed_action: Consolidate the four identical `SequentialMockSession` type-alias declarations — `iTunesArtworkServiceTests.SequentialMockSession` (line 84), `LastFMArtworkServiceTests.SequentialMockSession` (line 211), `DiscogsArtworkServiceTests.SequentialMockSession` (line 317), and a second `DiscogsArtworkServiceTests.SequentialMockSession` (line 363) — into a single top-level or file-scoped type alias declared once in `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift`. Each per-test-class alias can then be removed, with the inner test classes referencing the shared alias directly.
specifics.why_no_category_fits: All four records live in the same file (`ArtworkFetcherTests.swift`) and the same package (`Artwork`), so `extract-to-common` (which requires moving across packages or files) is not the right fit. They are type aliases, not protocol conformers, so `default-implementation` and `pat-introduction` do not apply. They are not classes with a shared base, so `subclass-lift` does not apply. The duplication is purely a within-file, within-test-suite redundancy: the same alias is re-declared under three (or four) different enclosing test-class namespaces. The idiomatic fix is to hoist the alias to file scope once, which none of the named categories describe precisely. Note also that the pipeline has flagged `is_test=false` on all records despite the file path (`Tests/ArtworkTests/`) and the names (`…Tests.SequentialMockSession`) strongly suggesting these are test-support type aliases; the structural fix is the same regardless.
